author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
rationale: gray_q is a Gray conversion of a counter; bits 3:1 have depth-2 chains but bit 0 is captured once into s2_q[0]: Gray not fully synchronized, CDC-017 primary (as CDC-003, ERROR) ahead of CDC-032/CDC-004 per CDC.md order. Reader A's notes (no binary init, no Gray datapath bound) do not apply: CDC-018 is only reached when every bit is synchronized.

author_reading.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
author_reading.rationale: Gray pointer: bits [3:1] have a two-stage chain but bit [0] is captured straight into the stage-2 register, so the pointer is only partly synchronized.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: The registered Gray conversion feeds two capture stages on bits 3:1 and a single stage on bit 0. gray_o includes an uncontained bit with different capture latency.
labels.suspected_flaw: The binary counter lacks startup initialization. The upper lanes also lack a reviewed Gray datapath bound.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: The 4-bit Gray-coded pointer gray_q[3:0] (clk_a, design.sv:14) is only partially synchronized into clk_b: bits [3:1] traverse 2 stages (s1_q[3:1] -> s2_q[3:1]), whereas bit 0 bypasses s1_q and is captured directly into s2_q[0] in a single stage (design.sv:19), leaving bit 0 unsynchronized and skewing pointer coherence (CDC-017 ERROR Established).
